items.source_situation: A hospital monitoring system emits frequent low-value alarms. Nurses become desensitized and later respond too slowly to a real safety alarm.

expected_frame.goal: preserve attention for important danger
expected_frame.strategy: emit frequent warnings to avoid missing possible hazards
expected_frame.turning_point: operators learn that too many alarms have low value
expected_frame.outcome: a genuinely important later warning receives too little response

items.source_situation: A bank sends customers so many low-quality account fraud warnings that customers learn to ignore them; later a genuine account takeover warning is dismissed.

expected_frame.goal: preserve response to a genuinely important warning
expected_frame.strategy: repeatedly use a warning channel for low-value alerts
expected_frame.turning_point: receivers update their belief that the warning channel is unreliable
expected_frame.outcome: a later genuine warning is ignored

items.source_situation: A chess player voluntarily gives up a pawn because the local material loss creates development and positional compensation that matters more to the whole game.

expected_frame.goal: improve the overall strategic position rather than maximize each local gain
expected_frame.strategy: sacrifice a local resource for broader compensation
expected_frame.turning_point: the local sacrifice changes the global configuration of the contest
expected_frame.outcome: the global positional gain can justify the local loss

items.source_situation: A bank deliberately accepts a loss on one customer segment so that scarce capital can be matched against more valuable opportunities across the full portfolio, improving aggregate return.

expected_frame.goal: maximize aggregate outcome rather than every local outcome
expected_frame.strategy: accept one local loss and rematch resources across opportunities
expected_frame.turning_point: resources are reassigned across local contests instead of evaluated one by one
expected_frame.outcome: a local sacrifice enables a better aggregate result

items.source_situation: A flight-control team reuses software whose numeric assumptions were safe on an older vehicle, but the new trajectory exceeds those assumptions and turns reuse into a system failure.

expected_frame.goal: reuse a proven component in a new system
expected_frame.strategy: carry forward a model built under assumptions from the previous environment
expected_frame.turning_point: the new environment violates an inherited operating assumption
expected_frame.outcome: a previously safe assumption becomes a system-level failure

items.source_situation: A bank keeps using an elegant risk model calibrated to a stable mortgage market after the market regime changes. The model remains internally coherent but its assumptions no longer match the world.

expected_frame.goal: apply abstract expertise successfully in practice
expected_frame.strategy: rely on a formal model without sufficiently adapting to new feedback
expected_frame.turning_point: real conditions invalidate assumptions that were adequate in the old model
expected_frame.outcome: the plan fails because theory does not adapt to the environment

items.source_situation: Each herder gains most of the benefit from adding another animal to a shared pasture while the depletion cost is spread across everyone, so individually attractive choices ruin the commons.

expected_frame.goal: maximize individual benefit from a shared resource
expected_frame.strategy: increase personal extraction while externalizing part of the depletion cost
expected_frame.turning_point: many individually rational extractions accumulate into system-level depletion
expected_frame.outcome: the shared resource deteriorates for everyone

items.source_situation: A subscription company tries to pull years of customer value forward through aggressive fees and extraction, but in doing so destroys trust and retention, eliminating the recurring revenue stream it wanted to monetize.

expected_frame.goal: capture future gains immediately
expected_frame.strategy: extract the expected recurring value too aggressively in the present
expected_frame.turning_point: the extraction destroys the source of recurring value
expected_frame.outcome: short-term extraction eliminates long-term returns

items.source_situation: After a new road opens, every driver chooses the route that appears fastest for them. Those individually sensible choices alter congestion and make everyone's equilibrium travel time worse.

expected_frame.goal: improve individual outcomes using available choices
expected_frame.strategy: each user chooses the locally best option
expected_frame.turning_point: the added option changes everyone's behavior and therefore the shared system
expected_frame.outcome: individually rational choices create a worse collective equilibrium

items.source_situation: Independent software teams each consume extra capacity from a shared API because the local benefit belongs to their own product while slowdown costs are spread across all teams; the shared service degrades.

expected_frame.goal: maximize individual benefit from a shared resource
expected_frame.strategy: increase personal extraction while distributing the system cost across others
expected_frame.turning_point: many individually rational uses accumulate into system-level depletion
expected_frame.outcome: the shared resource deteriorates for everyone

items.source_situation: A video-rental incumbent remains organized around stores and legacy revenue while customers move to subscription and streaming, making its existing asset base increasingly costly to abandon.

expected_frame.goal: retain market position during a distribution shift
expected_frame.strategy: continue relying on a legacy model while adapting incrementally
expected_frame.turning_point: consumer behavior shifts away from the incumbent's existing asset base
expected_frame.outcome: legacy infrastructure loses strategic value as the market reorganizes

items.source_situation: A political institution built around an old media environment keeps exploiting procedures that once made it dominant, even after public communication moves to a new medium; yesterday's strength becomes a constraint on adaptation.

expected_frame.goal: preserve an established position while adapting to environmental change
expected_frame.strategy: continue exploiting a strong legacy model while responding incrementally to a disruptive transition
expected_frame.turning_point: value migrates away from the incumbent's strongest legacy capabilities
expected_frame.outcome: legacy strengths become constraints during the transition

items.source_situation: A relief army avoids attacking the enemy's strongest siege line and instead threatens the attacker's vulnerable base, forcing the attacker to redeploy and relieving the original target indirectly.

expected_frame.goal: relieve pressure on an ally
expected_frame.strategy: attack a dependency or vulnerable base rather than the strongest defended point
expected_frame.turning_point: the attacker must protect its own base instead of continuing the original offensive
expected_frame.outcome: pressure on the original target is relieved indirectly

items.source_situation: A cyber defender does not fight thousands of infected devices one by one. It disables the command infrastructure those devices depend on, changing the attacker's incentives and causing the distributed attack to lose coordination.

expected_frame.goal: relieve pressure on the defended target
expected_frame.strategy: attack a dependency or vulnerable control base instead of the strongest visible attack surface
expected_frame.turning_point: the attacker loses or must protect a critical dependency
expected_frame.outcome: pressure on the original target is relieved indirectly

items.source_situation: A bank rewards employees for hitting aggressive account and cross-selling targets. Employees optimize the measured number by creating unwanted accounts, so the metric rises while customer value falls.

expected_frame.goal: increase genuine customer adoption and organizational value
expected_frame.strategy: set strong numerical targets and incentives
expected_frame.turning_point: employees optimize the measured proxy in ways that diverge from the real objective
expected_frame.outcome: the metric improves while trust and underlying value are damaged

items.source_situation: A university judges research quality mainly by paper count. Researchers respond by slicing work into many minimally distinct papers, increasing the measured output while reducing the metric's connection to the underlying quality it was meant to represent.

expected_frame.goal: increase genuine performance and quality
expected_frame.strategy: use a simple numerical output target as the performance proxy
expected_frame.turning_point: agents optimize the measured target rather than the underlying objective
expected_frame.outcome: measured performance rises while the true objective is damaged

items.source_situation: A bank fraud team receives so many low-value account alerts from its monitoring system that analysts learn to dismiss them. Months later a genuinely dangerous account alert arrives, but it is ignored because the warning channel has lost credibility.

expected_frame.goal: surface genuine threats so analysts respond appropriately
expected_frame.strategy: emit frequent alerts whenever suspicious account activity is detected
expected_frame.turning_point: repeated low-value alerts teach analysts to discount the warning channel
expected_frame.outcome: a genuine threat alert is ignored because prior false or low-value signals depleted credibility

items.source_situation: A hospital evaluates nurses mainly by the number of electronic alerts they close each shift. Nurses learn to dismiss or batch-close alerts to hit the target, so the dashboard improves while actual patient-safety performance deteriorates.

expected_frame.goal: improve genuine patient-safety performance
expected_frame.strategy: reward a simple numerical target for alerts closed
expected_frame.turning_point: staff optimize the measured target rather than the underlying safety objective
expected_frame.outcome: the metric improves while real patient-safety value deteriorates

items.source_situation: A company deliberately accepts a loss in one small customer segment so it can reassign scarce sales capacity to better-matched accounts, increasing total portfolio return even though one local result looks worse.

expected_frame.goal: maximize total portfolio performance rather than every local result
expected_frame.strategy: accept a local loss and rematch scarce resources to higher-value opportunities
expected_frame.turning_point: resources are evaluated by system-level contribution rather than local win rate
expected_frame.outcome: one local loss enables a better aggregate outcome

items.source_situation: A political organization dominates television-era campaigning and keeps investing in the routines, staff, and procedures that made it powerful there. As public attention migrates to a new communication medium, those accumulated strengths become costly constraints on adaptation.

expected_frame.goal: preserve influence during an environmental transition
expected_frame.strategy: continue exploiting strong legacy capabilities while adapting only incrementally
expected_frame.turning_point: value migrates away from the environment where the incumbent legacy system is strongest
expected_frame.outcome: past strengths become constraints that slow adaptation
